identifier.rule: UCNS is a stable identifier. Any expansion is an alias or provenance description only and cannot become schema authority, mathematical canon, or implementation law.

project.system_root: UCNS assigns elements of an unknowable to completion through geometric motion.
project.completion_scope: Completion closes a declared construction relative to its declared boundary and does not exhaust the underlying unknowable.
project.objective: Expose UCNS choices and determine an EDCM-scoped ideal option configuration against real systems.
project.ucns_role: Provide explicit, versioned, composable, provenance-bearing choices without hidden global defaults.
project.edcm_role: Test configurations against declared systems and readouts, retain failures, and support an explicit EDCM-scoped selection decision.
project.selection_principle: Refuse early collapse. Run each admitted corpus in full, then surface the configurations and cases that expose incompleteness, disagreement, and worst-case behavior rather than flattering current examples.

standing_vocabulary.decided-constraint: Required within the declared scope; not a universal default outside that scope.
standing_vocabulary.implemented-candidate: Executable current construction awaiting comparative selection.
standing_vocabulary.experiment-candidate: Available for falsifiable comparison with no selected winner.
standing_vocabulary.required-evaluation: Must be represented and tested before the affected decision may close.
standing_vocabulary.rejected-pre-reset: Excluded from current activation; retained with historical evidence.
standing_vocabulary.unresolved: The choice boundary or admissible constructions are not yet complete.
standing_vocabulary.superseded-for-edcm: Excluded from the EDCM target configuration; retained only for compatibility, comparison, or provenance.

decisions.statement: UCNS has no canonical expansion.
UCNS exposes choices as explicit configurations; registration or implementation does not appoint a global default.
Old and new lineages are decomposed into individual choices with evidence and standing rather than restored or rejected wholesale.
The current project uses EDCM experiments against real systems to determine an EDCM-scoped ideal UCNS configuration.
An EDCM-scoped selection does not become universal UCNS canon and transfers no theorem, EDCM measurement, or METAPAT validity.
Producer epoch, profile, bridge schema, source identity, and complete option values participate in configuration identity and must fail closed on mismatch.
The initial EDCM profile preserves order, multiplicity, occurrence identity, left-right sidedness, algebraic zero, and retained layers outside scalar support.
A changed or failed result is evidence about a choice boundary, not automatically a regression and not permission to rewrite earlier reports.
NA is distinct from numeric or structural zero.
EDCM requires the Mobius twist because its interpretation of space as singular and superpositioned supplies a load-bearing causal chain for later hyper-dimensional letter and word relations.
For EDCM, Structural Null is superpositioned space and the twist occurs when a new gonol initiates.
EDCM requires ordered concatenation; multiset and set views may exist only as explicit information-losing projections.
One complete speaker turn has one unit of EDCM support; token count, word count, and text extent do not alter that support.
Exact evidence is the EDCM baseline. Projection may increase only along an explicit sliding scale justified by accumulated experimental understanding and recorded information loss.
EDCM displays geometric-mean, maximum-support, and minimum-support M candidates together; no single M candidate is selected.
EDCM displays cell-log-support, cell-detail, and retained-presence B candidates together pending more information.
EDCM uses carrier pairing only; typed payload dispatch remains outside the active configuration pending more information.
The target configuration requires an EDCM-specific profile rather than a combined EDCM-METAPAT profile.
Real-system corpora are required before an EDCM option selection can close.
Every admitted corpus is run in full. Failure-seeking occurs in post-run comparison and surfacing, not by sampling a flattering or adversarial subset.
The word is the smallest EDCM gonol. Character tokens compose each word gonol, and every larger gonol must compose from word gonols without flattening the SPACE nesting boundary.
EDCM token identity is the exact public 157-position Unicode code-point fixture from The-Interdependency/a0-betatest at its recorded source commit and SHA-256 digest.

The EDCM source domain is Unicode scalar values: surrogate code points are rejected, while valid carrier-unassigned witnesses such as private-use U+E000, reserved U+0378, and noncharacter U+FDD0 remain exact ordered evidence rather than being coerced into carrier membership.
Every source code point in the profile-pinned Unicode White_Space set assigns to the U+0020 public-gonol origin while its exact source value, code point, and offset remain unchanged.
Authoritative EDCM evidence is never Unicode-normalized or folded. Exact source code points are preserved; any NFC view is a separately named comparison projection with recorded divergence.
EDCM configuration experiments run every turn in each admitted corpus. Sampling and holdout partitioning do not define the current execution protocol.
UCNS assigns elements of an unknowable to completion through geometric motion; carrier, algebra, factorization, hashes, and scalars remain subordinate instruments or projections.
Completion closes only a declared construction relative to its declared boundary and cannot claim epistemic exhaustion of the underlying unknowable.
The complete assignment-and-motion trajectory is the EDCM observation identity; any scalar is an optional declared-loss projection linked to its retained source trajectory.

The exact rational framed Mobius root loop has a reversible source-preserving chart into the first and second directed-cover representatives for the complete minimum witness packet; this evidence is bounded, nonselecting, and does not establish transverse, radial, arbitrary-element, higher-geometric, or completion equivalence.

The v0.8 transverse construction is an exact sidecar envelope over the v0.7 root chart, not a transverse directed-cover embedding. v0.9 retains reversible local-frame and global-side descriptions under a named exact comparison policy, validates complete witness identities, and records actual-cover collisions without extending F12/F13 or selecting a carrier or convention.

v0.10 evaluates four explicit radial candidate laws in actual LiftedCarrierPoint breadth and angle fields over the complete 45-fiber exact-rational stress domain. The signed local affine radial law is injective, zero-restricting, convention-invariant, and motion-commuting on that declared domain; constant breadth and unsigned radial laws retain collision witnesses, and the signed global law retains odd-motion failures. Every candidate remains an experiment-candidate with selection effect none.

current_profile.boundary: This exact combined profile remains an implemented compatibility candidate with no selection effect. It does not yet implement the decided EDCM-specific Mobius, superpositioned Structural Null, or new-gonol twist constraints and is therefore ineligible as the target EDCM configuration.

dimensions.question: How must the EDCM carrier realize the critical Mobius causal chain while preserving the useful directed-cover distinctions?

choices.evidence: Current executable 720-degree lifted and 360-degree visible implementation. The v0.7 root-loop chart is exact on its declared domain. v0.9 corrects the attempted v0.8 transverse extension by showing that distinct sidecar states collide at the same actual directed-cover coordinate. v0.10 evaluates four explicit radial laws in actual LiftedCarrierPoint fields: signed local affine breadth is admissible on the declared 45-fiber rational domain, while three alternatives retain collision or motion-failure witnesses. No candidate is selected, and global continuity, arbitrary-element assignment, higher geometry, and completion remain unresolved.
Required for EDCM: the twist interprets space as singular and superpositioned and supplies a causal chain needed by the future hyper-dimensional lattice relating letters and words.

dimensions.question: Which declared transverse-to-directed-cover coordinate laws satisfy actual-cover injectivity, zero-fiber restriction, convention invariance, and motion commutation on the bounded v0.10 domain?

choices.evidence: Rejected on the declared domain: all distinct transverse fibers at one root collide in the same actual LiftedCarrierPoint coordinate.
Rejected on the declared domain: opposite signed transverse fibers collide because absolute magnitude discards side.

Admissible on the declared 45-fiber exact-rational domain: B(u)=1+u/2 is positive, injective after actual-cover materialization, restricts u=0 to the v0.7 root, is convention-invariant, and commutes with declared root motion. This is bounded evidence, not selection or canonical faithful breadth.
Rejected on the declared domain: the coordinate is fiber-injective but fails to commute with odd root-loop motion because the global side reverses while actual carrier rotation preserves breadth.

dimensions.question: How does superpositioned Structural Null become a gonol through the initiating Mobius twist?

choices.evidence: EDCM defines Structural Null as the singular superpositioned space before a gonol initiates.
The twist occurs when a new gonol initiates, supplying the transition and causal chain from superpositioned space into an individuated carrier.
Current directed-cover implementation. It may remain comparison evidence but cannot define the target EDCM origin semantics by itself.
Historical normalization erased origin testimony and remains excluded.

May be derived only for a named readout that records loss of order and multiplicity; it is not an EDCM primary representation.

dimensions.question: What is the smallest EDCM gonol, and how may larger scales be formed without flattening the nesting boundary?

choices.evidence: The word is the smallest gonol. Its ordered character tokens initiate through the Mobius twist, and all larger gonols compose from word gonols.
Characters are the 157 tokens within a word gonol; treating each character as a gonol collapses the decided scale distinction.
A speaker turn supplies unit support and ordering, but is not a flat bag or the smallest gonol.

dimensions.question: How is corpus text related to the exact 157-token EDCM alphabet?

choices.evidence: Use the exact source-provenance fixture and digest. Each position contains one Unicode code point; U+0020 SPACE is the position-zero carrier token.
Observe Unicode scalar values and reject surrogate code points. Valid carrier-unassigned scalar witnesses remain exact evidence without acquiring public-gonol membership.

The profile-pinned Unicode White_Space set assigns to carrier position zero. Raw source code points, offsets, and reconstruction remain exact, so this is a carrier assignment rather than whitespace normalization or collapse.
Unmapped non-SPACE corpus code points remain in exact order and are reported as alphabet-coverage failures rather than dropped or coerced.
Full-corpus evidence must show whether the 157-token boundary needs a named escape, another carrier, or no expansion at all.

dimensions.question: What Unicode transformation, if any, may act on authoritative EDCM evidence?

choices.evidence: Strict UTF-8 decoding followed by exact code-point observation. No source mutation is authorized.
Canonical-equivalence comparison may be useful only as a separately named projection that preserves the raw source and records every changed sequence.
NFKC/NFKD, case folding, whitespace collapse, quote or dash folding, confusable mapping, and similar transforms erase token or nesting distinctions.

dimensions.question: Does the EDCM configuration experiment run samples or the complete admitted corpus?

choices.evidence: Run every speaker turn in source order. Failure-seeking is a post-run comparison and surfacing rule.
Sampling was an earlier proposal and is not the current EDCM execution protocol.
Partitioned execution is not required for the present configuration-discovery runs; external prediction studies may define separate protocols later.

target_profile.boundary: This profile makes exact Unicode-scalar corpus observation executable, rejects surrogate code points, and assigns a pinned set of source-preserved SPACE manifestations to the carrier origin. Valid carrier-unassigned scalar witnesses remain exact evidence and do not become public-gonol members. The profile records the required Mobius initiation event but does not claim to supply the unresolved Mobius coordinate construction or higher-gonol composition law.
